system.description: You once underwent the Vaulderie, willingly or not, and have since been redeemed and welcomed back into Clan Tremere — but the mark of the Betrayer never fades, and every Tremere can sense it on you. You suffer a two-Trait penalty to Social challenges with other (non-Sabbat) Tremere who are loyal to the clan, and those who don't know your history may assume you're still a Sabbat agent and act accordingly. Any further failure or relapse and you can expect to be hunted down exactly as the clan hunts its other threats.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
